verdict.rationale: AgentMail's docs say all of its SDKs are open source under the MIT license, so part of the product's own code can be read under an open license. The core hosted email service is not shown to be open source. missing for 10: an open-source license for the core service/backend, open-source status of the CLI and MCP server, a public repository link, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: All of our SDKs are open source and available under the MIT license.
